lines.trans: Hi Mom, things are not going well.
What is going on, my sweetie?
At the agency, it is a real hell!
They are all jealous of me.
Herve will not even talk to me anymore.
He calls me Judas all day long.
Andrea is always yelling at me.

words.gloss: upon, on (crier dessus = to yell at)

lines.trans: I cannot take it anymore, Mom!

words.gram: ne + en: adverbial pronoun in 'en pouvoir plus'

lines.trans: Do not cry, my little girl.
Come home with me.
Work must not be painful.
I will pay for your ticket.
We will go together to the beach.
Thank you Mom, I will think about it.

before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.trans: My mum lives in the South.

with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille
merci beaucoup = thank you very much
before the noun: le même lifting
as an adverb: même Andréa = even Andréa
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never
everyday speech, with a he/she verb form
